scope: Windows Git metadata watcher atomic replacement fixture; no production code changed

originalFailure.limitation: Original helper returned only bool, so its precise failing stage/error and the overlapping handle owner cannot be recovered from that log.

boundedFocusedBurstRunsBeforeCorrection.meaning: Separate reproduction runs, not retries inside a test and not converted historical failures.

reproduction.deterministicQtFailure: Holding GENERIC_READ with FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_WRITE|FILE_SHARE_DELETE makes QSaveFile::commit fail RenameError / Access is denied / Win32 5 in this environment.
reproduction.nativeProbeConclusion: MoveFileExW(MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING) fails with Win32 5 while the destination handle is open, including desired access 0 and delete sharing. ReplaceFileW succeeds with GENERIC_READ plus read/write/delete sharing; denying delete sharing produces Win32 32.
reproduction.productionInspection: GitRepositoryWatcher readHead/rootProbe and gitdetail::canonical already grant read/write/delete sharing; no missing-delete-share defect was found.

change.helper: Windows: write and flush same-directory QTemporaryFile, destroy its handle, then call ReplaceFileW exactly once; preserve diagnostic error. Other platforms retain QSaveFile. No retry or non-atomic fallback.
regressions: Replacement succeeds while old shared reader retains its original bytes; incompatible no-delete reader fails with Win32 32 and target remains unchanged.
200 first-attempt 96KiB metadata replacements while active watcher scans run; final contents and topology notification checked.
20 real git symbolic-ref HEAD commands while scans run, without fixture retries; final contents and notification checked.
change.preserved: Original burst/debounce, watch reattachment, bounds, identity, cancellation, service integration and lifetime assertions remain.

verification.sharedBuild: Root integration rerun pending; this evidence is an isolated build of current production Git sources and the amended test.

limits: Does not prove universal freedom from Windows filesystem contention, antivirus or third-party handles.
Native probe identifies a fixture operation incompatibility; exact handle ownership at the original full-suite failure was not recorded.
Actual Git may implement its own normal platform retry policy; the fixture does not retry any Git command.
Windows replacement/share behavior was exercised on this machine; non-Windows branch was not executed.

finalSharedIntegration.scope: Named suite reports and exact tested source hashes are retained in the final aggregate. Focused/historical evidence above remains scoped to its original observation; full upstream parity is not implied.
